- **White_Mold/stem/56**: Closest match — bleached pale stem with fluffy white mold growth and dead leaves remaining attached. This is the most visually similar.

- All other candidates (Phytophthora, SDS, Fusarium, Rhizoctonia, Anthracnose) showed darker brown/reddish lesions or were field views not matching the bleached stem appearance.

**Key matching features for White_Mold:**
- Bleached white/pale stem — characteristic of White Mold ("infected stems become bleached white")
- Dead/wilted leaves remaining attached to the stem ("leaves turn gray-green then brown and remain attached")
- Whole plant pulled from ground showing stem collapse
